name: memory-wiki
description: Central memory + LLM wiki for Claude Code: memory in every request, each turn curated by the server, global skills synced from the server.

server_url.title: Memory server URL
server_url.description: The memory-wiki-all-you-need server, e.g. http://<server>:8765 (MEMORY_SERVER_URL overrides it)

timeout_ms.title: Memory fetch timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long a prompt waits for the memory block before going on without it

settle_delay_ms.title: Turn send delay (ms)
settle_delay_ms.description: Wait after a turn before sending it for curation; a prompt in between sends both together

project.title: Fixed project key
project.description: Use this project key instead of the git origin (empty = from git)

skill_nudge.title: Skill nudge (tool calls)
skill_nudge.description: After a turn with this many tool calls, hint Claude to save the procedure as a skill (0 = off)

mirror_skills.title: Install global skills
mirror_skills.description: Mirror the server's global skills into the Claude Code skills folder (project skills are always read with skill_manage)

show_activity.title: Show memory activity
show_activity.description: Log a line in the conversation when memories are recalled for a prompt and when a turn's curation changed memories (never sent to Claude)
